title.en: An Act Establishing An Information and Communications Technology High School in the Municipality of Pili, Province of Camarines Sur to Be Known as the Computer Science High School of Bicolandia and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing An Information and Communications Technology High School in the Municipality of Pili, Province of Camarines Sur to Be Known as the Computer Science High School of Bicolandia and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Công nghệ Information and Communications tại Đô thị Pili, Tỉnh Camarines Sur với tên gọi Trường Trung học Khoa học Computer Bicolandia, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเทคโนโลยี Information and Communications ในเทศบาล Pili จังหวัด Camarines Sur ในชื่อ โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาวิทยาศาสตร์ Computer Bicolandia และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Teknologi Information and Communications di Kotamadya Pili, Provinsi Camarines Sur dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Sains Computer Bicolandia, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Teknologi Information and Communications di Perbandaran Pili, Wilayah Camarines Sur dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Sains Computer Bicolandia, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: Establishment of an Information and Communications Technology High School. – There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, an information and communications technology high school in the Municipality of Pili, Province of Camarines Sur to be known as the Computer Science High School of Bicolandia.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Computer Science High School of Bicolandia, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
